text:
Maya Rivera: Quick check — who's up for something outdoors this weekend? thinking low-effort, maybe kayak + tacos on sunday.
Joel Chen: I'm in for tacos. kayak depends on weather but count me for beach vibes :sunglasses: :taco:
Samir Patel: Kiddo's soccer on Saturday so i'm out then, but sunday afternoon sounds perfect. Any launch spots?
Lucy: There’s a little public launch at Crissy Field parking lot. Free street parking if you get there early. 9am-ish meet?
Maya Rivera: 9am works. I'll bring dry bags and a spare paddle. anyone want to carpool from SOMA?
Joel Chen: I can swing by SOMA at 8:15, capacity for 2 in my car. ping me if you want a ride.
Samir Patel: If someone could grab an extra life jacket for me that'd be great (i forgot to throw ours in the trunk).
Lucy: I have a small kids/adult adjustable jacket i can bring.
Maya Rivera: ok plan: meet @ SOMA @ 8:15 (carpool), launch @ Crissy Field 9am, tacos after at La Taqueria? open to other recs.
Joel Chen: La Taqueria lines are wild but worth it. also willing to hit Tacolicious if y'all prefer shorter wait :shrug:
Samir Patel: Tacolicious for the shorter line — vote?
Maya Rivera: vote: Tacolicious :thumbsup:
Lucy: vote: Tacolicious :thumbsup:
Joel Chen: Tacolicious it is. also: bring sunscreen + hats.
CoffeeBot: Poll created: "Weekend plan: Kayak + Tacos" — 3 votes for Tacolicious, 0 for La Taqueria. Poll closes in 2h.
Samir Patel: sweet. thanks for organizing Maya. see y'all sunday!
Maya Rivera: Will post exact address in #lunch-plans channel tomorrow morning and DM drivers. :raised_hands:
Lucy: If weather looks bad i'll post an alternate coffee-and-boardgames plan.
Joel Chen: Fingers crossed for sun. :crossed_fingers:
